citations.long: The quality control unit lacks the responsibility and authority to reject all drug products.

citations.short: Procedures not  in writing, fully followed
citations.long: The responsibilities and procedures applicable to the quality control unit are not in writing.

citations.short: Buildings not maintained in good state of repair
citations.long: Buildings used in the manufacturing, processing, packing, and holding of a drug product are not maintained in a good state of repair.
Equipment and utensils are not cleaned at appropriate intervals to prevent contamination that would alter the safety, identity, strength, quality or purity of the drug product.

Equipment surfaces that contact components, in-process materials, and drug products are reactive, additive or absorptive so as to alter the safety, identity, strength, quality, or purity of the drug product beyond the official or other established requirements.
Established laboratory control mechanisms are not followed and documented at the time of performance.
Laboratory records are deficient in that they do not include a complete record of all data obtained during testing.
